एड एड, अस्, आ, अम्, deaf; (अस्), m. a kind
of sheep.
—एड-गज, अस्, m. the medicinal plant
Cassia Tora or Alata, used for the cure of ring-worm.
—एड-मूक, अस्, आ, अम्, deaf and dumb; wicked,
perverse.

एडक, अस्, m. a kind of sheep, a ram, a wild
goat; a certain medicinal plant; (आ), f. a ewe.
